description: This file contains the implementation of Bootstrap's dropdown component (version 3.3.7), including class definitions, event handling, and plugin registration for dropdown menus.

classes.name: Dropdown
classes.description: Class representing the dropdown component, handling toggle, keyboard navigation, and event triggers.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Retrieves the parent element of the dropdown based on data-target or href attribute.

methods.name: clearMenus
methods.description: Closes any open dropdown menus and removes backdrop elements.

methods.name: Dropdown.prototype.toggle
methods.description: Toggles the dropdown menu open or closed, handling mobile backdrops and triggering events.

methods.name: Dropdown.prototype.keydown
methods.description: Handles keyboard navigation within dropdown menus for accessibility.
